# setup
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr, exclude = "fixed")
library(dplyr, exclude = "col_factor")
library(recipes, exclude = "fixed")

source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/format_path.R?raw=true")
source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/study_llmpanel/blob/main/_chtc/training_controls_panel_glmnet.R?raw=true")

path_processed <- format_path("llmpanel/data_processed")
panel <- read_csv(here::here(path_processed, "panel.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
d <- format_data(panel)

baked <- glmnet_configs |>
  purrr::pmap(function(algorithm, feature_set) {
    config <- tibble(algorithm = algorithm, feature_set = feature_set)
    build_recipe(d, config) |>
      prep(training = d) |>
      bake(new_data = NULL)
  }) |>
  purrr::set_names(glmnet_configs$feature_set)

d_ordinal <- baked$edu_ordinal

d_collapsed <- baked$edu_collapsed
```

# Ordinal Education Feature set
```{r}
d_ordinal |> colnames()
```
No anomalous interaction columns!

```{r}
# In d_collapsed but not d_ordinal
setdiff(colnames(d_collapsed), colnames(d_ordinal))
```

Interaction columns are expanded across all three categories of education in this config, as intended.

```{r}
# In d_ordinal but not d_collapsed

setdiff(colnames(d_ordinal), colnames(d_collapsed))
```

The numeric dem_education column and related interactions are removed, as intended.

```{r}
glimpse(d_ordinal)
```

```{r}
glimpse(d_collapsed)
```
